back_translation: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the house of the LORD, which faces east; and behold, at the entrance of the gate were twenty-five men, and among them I saw Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.
He said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who plot evil and give wicked counsel in this city,
who say, ‘Is not the time near to build houses? This city is the pot, and we are the meat.’
Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, son of man!”
Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon me and told me to declare: The LORD says this: “You say such things, O house of Israel, and I know what rises in your minds.
You have killed many in this city and filled its streets with the slain.
Therefore the Lord GOD says this: The slain you have laid in its midst are the meat, and this city is the pot; but I will bring you out of it.
You fear the sword, and I will bring the sword against you, declares the Lord GOD.
I will bring you out of the city and deliver you into the hands of foreigners, and I will execute judgments against you.
You will fall by the sword; I will judge you at the border of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
This city will not be a pot for you, nor will you be the meat within it. I will judge you at the border of Israel.
Then you will know that I am the LORD, for you have not followed My statutes or kept My ordinances, but have acted according to the ordinances of the nations around you.”
While I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. Then I fell facedown and cried out in a loud voice, “Ah, Lord GOD, will You bring the remnant of Israel to a complete end?”
Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

“Son of man, your brothers—your relatives, your fellow exiles, and the whole house of Israel—are those of whom the people of Jerusalem say, ‘They are far from the LORD; this land has been given to us as a possession.’

Therefore say, the Lord GOD says this: ‘Although I sent them far away among the nations and scattered them among the countries, yet for a little while I have been a sanctuary for them in the countries where they have gone.’
Therefore say, the Lord GOD says this: ‘I will gather you from the peoples and assemble you from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you back the land of Israel.’
When they return to it, they will remove all its detestable things and all its abominations from it.
I will give them one heart and put a new spirit within you; I will remove the heart of stone from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh,
so that they may follow My statutes, keep My ordinances, and practice them. Then they will be My people, and I will be their God.
But as for those whose heart goes after their detestable things and abominations, I will bring their conduct down upon their own heads, declares the Lord GOD.”
Then the cherubim spread their wings, with the wheels beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
And the glory of the LORD rose up from within the city and stood over the mountain east of the city.
Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me back to Chaldea, to the exiles, in the vision by the Spirit of God; and the vision I had seen went up from me.
Then I told the exiles all the things the LORD had shown me.
